Class GUIApplication

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
it.polimi.ingsw.view.graphic.GUIApplication
public class GUIApplication extends javafx.application.Application
GUIApplication is the main entry point for a graphical user interface (GUI) application extending the class from JavaFX. It manages the setup and initialization for both a network-based client-server communication through sockets and an RMI-based communication model
